message.reasoning:
We need to produce a test class that tests JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(URI). Need to set up dependencies: JsonSchemaFactory constructor requires ObjectMapper jsonMapper, ObjectMapper yamlMapper, String defaultMetaSchemaURI, SchemaLoaders.Builder schemaLoadersBuilder, SchemaMappers.Builder schemaMappersBuilder, Map<String, JsonMetaSchema> jsonMetaSchemas, boolean enableUriSchemaCache.

We need to create an instance of JsonSchemaFactory for testing. Use mocks for ObjectMapper, JsonMetaSchema, maybe default meta schema URI. Provide minimal map containing default meta schema. Also need to provide defaultMetaSchemaURI string that matches a key in map after normalizeMetaSchemaUri (static method). The normalizeMetaSchemaUri probably normalizes; we can just use same string as key.

We need to test that getSchema(URI) returns a JsonSchema (maybe a mock). The method getSchema(URI) delegates to getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(schemaUri.toString()), createSchemaValidatorsConfig()). So we need to stub createSchemaValidatorsConfig? It's protected, but we can rely on default behavior. However getSchema(SchemaLocation, config) will eventually call getMappedSchema etc. Might be complex. Instead we can use spy on JsonSchemaFactory and mock the internal method getMappedSchema to return a mock JsonSchema, then verify that getSchema(URI) returns that mock.

We must not invoke private methods or fields. Using spy is okay; we can override behavior of protected methods using Mockito's doReturn.

So steps:

- In setupBeforeEach, create mocks: ObjectMapper jsonMapperMock, yamlMapperMock, JsonMetaSchema metaSchemaMock.

- Create map: Map<String, JsonMetaSchema> metaSchemas = new HashMap<>(); metaSchemas.put("http://example.com/meta-schema", metaSchemaMock);

- Instantiate JsonSchemaFactory via its constructor (needs many args). Use real constructor: new JsonSchemaFactory(jsonMapperMock, yamlMapperMock, "http://example.com/meta-schema", new SchemaLoaders.Builder(), new SchemaMappers.Builder(), metaSchemas, false);

- Then spy: JsonSchemaFactory factorySpy = Mockito.spy(factory);

- Mock behavior of protected method getMappedSchema: when(factorySpy.getMappedSchema(any(SchemaLocation.class), any(SchemaValidatorsConfig.class))).thenReturn(mock(JsonSchema.class));

- In test method, call factorySpy.getSchema(new URI("http://example.com/schema.json")); assertNotNull and same as mock.

Add test method.

Also need imports: java.net.URI, java.util.HashMap, java.util.Map, com.networknt.schema.resource.SchemaLoaders, SchemaMappers, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper, com.networknt.schema.JsonMetaSchema, com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema, com.networknt.schema.SchemaValidatorsConfig, com.networknt.schema.SchemaLocation.

Add @Test method.

Teardown probably nothing.
